subject: MSA redlines: security exhibit alignment & evidence cadence
messages:
From: Chris Moore <chris.moore@medallionhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Medallion Legal <legal@medallionhealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA redlines: security exhibit + evidence cadence (v3)

Hi Grace / Laura,

Thanks for the quick turnaround last week. Counsel sent a consolidated set of redlines for the MSA and the security exhibit — attaching the PDF and a short redline summary. High level: Medallion is trying to limit open-ended inspection rights while preserving its ability to validate SOC 2 assertions and to run periodic penetration tests against our staging environment.

Key asks from their side:
- Audit rights to remain, but scoped to SOC2-relevant artifacts and a bounded sampling process (they propose up to 2 in-person/remote inspections per 12 months).
- Pen test language: they want the ability to run vendor-led tests in staging with 30 days' notice and an agreed test plan.
- Evidence cadence: quarterly artifact requests, with a turnaround expectation of 10 business days for reasonably scoped bundles.

Can you confirm Redwood's broad position on: (a) whether we can accept a bounded inspection model, (b) the 30-day pen-test notice (we may need a longer window), and (c) the 10 business-day evidence SLA? Also propose times for a short alignment call — we prefer Sep 2.

Attachments: medallion_msa_redlines_v3.pdf (PDF), redline_summary.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Chris
Chris Moore
Director, Security & Compliance (Medallion Health)
chris.moore@medallionhealth.com
Mobile: 415-555-0198

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Chris Moore <chris.moore@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines: security exhibit + evidence cadence (v3)

Chris — thanks for sending these. I reviewed the summary and looped in Karthik (legal) and Laura (assurance ops). Quick notes and suggested next steps:

- Bounded inspection: we are open to a scoped inspection model that maps to specific SOC 2 assertions. Redwood prefers remote-first evidence delivery and ephemeral access for any sensitive environments.
- Pen test notice: 30 days is tight for our scheduling and staging prep; propose 45 days notice with a mutually agreed test plan. We can commit to scheduling a canary window once per 6 months on Dedicated customers when needed.
- Evidence turnaround: Laura and the assurance team can deliver a scoped artifact bundle, but turnarounds depend on scope. 10 business days is reasonable for standard SOC2 artifacts; complex forensic or logs may take longer.

Let's do a 30-minute sync tomorrow (Sep 2) to align language and capture a mutual action plan. Proposed time: Sep 2, 10:00 AM PT. If that works, I will send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Action owner notes: Karthik to propose alternative clause text for audit rights / inspection boundary; Laura to draft evidence delivery template and expected response bands; Grace to coordinate the call and capture agreed timelines.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security (Redwood Inference)
[Attachment: none]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Chris Moore <chris.moore@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines: security exhibit + evidence cadence (v3)

Grace / Chris — I had a first pass at specific language that should bridge both parties' risk profiles. Draft excerpts below (for discussion on the call):

1) Audit / Inspection Clause (proposed):
"Inspection Rights: Customer may request reasonable inspection activities to verify Redwood's SOC 2-related controls. Such activities shall be limited to (i) review of SOC 2 reports and associated artifact bundles; (ii) remote interviews with designated operations staff; and (iii) staged environment testing as set out in the Penetration Testing section. On-site inspections shall not exceed two occasions per 12-month period without mutual written agreement. Access to production systems, backup media, or customer data stores is not permitted."

2) Evidence Delivery SLA (proposed):
"Requested SOC 2 artifact bundles will be provided within 10 business days for routinely maintained artifacts (policies, control evidence, SSAE artifacts). Requests requiring additional aggregation (logs, forensic reconstructions) will be tracked and delivered based on a mutually agreed timeline; Redwood will acknowledge inbound requests within 2 business days and provide an estimated delivery date."

3) Pen Test (proposed):
"Customer may execute penetration testing only against mutually agreed non-production/staging environments. Customer must provide a written test plan not less than forty‑five (45) calendar days in advance. Redwood will provide a single agreed test window and will require that testing is performed by a third-party provider acceptable to both parties. Redwood will not permit tests that require interactive access to production data or credentials. Post-test remediation coordination (including findings, severity classification, and follow-up retest) will be scheduled within mutually agreed timelines."

I attached a tracked-change doc (redline_draft.docx) with these edits inline. From a legal perspective the goals are: (A) preserve Medallion's ability to validate Redwood's SOC2 claims; (B) prevent unfettered access to prod/forensics; and (C) define notice & response SLAs.

If we can land on these high-level points in today's call, I'll push a clean redline back into DocuSign for signature-ready order form updates.

Attachments: redline_draft.docx

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts (Redwood Inference)
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Chris Moore <chris.moore@medallionhealth.com>

Cc: Medallion Legal <legal@medallionhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines: security exhibit + evidence cadence (v3)

Thanks — the call was useful. A few clarifications / confirmations from Medallion's side and agreed next steps: 

- We can accept the bounded inspection language as discussed, provided the sampling approach and assertion mapping are (1) documented in the exhibit and (2) limited to SOC2-related control families.
- Medallion needs a 45-day notice for pen tests (we proposed 30 initially; after the call we're ok moving to 45).
- Evidence SLA: we agree Redwood will acknowledge within 2 business days and will use 10 business days as a target for standard artifact bundles. For aggregated log requests we'll accept a project timeline approach.

Next steps / owners: 
- Karthik to finalize the tracked redline and circulate by 2027-09-07 (Karthik).
- Laura to prepare a sample artifact bundle template and a short runbook describing evidence request fields and expected response bands by 2027-09-06 (Laura).
- Grace to upload the agreed summary and calendar slots and to send the DocuSign room for the order form once legal finalizes redline (Grace).
- Medallion will circulate a brief compliance binder folder for our internal reviewers: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B7-medallion-compliance-binder

Attachment: action-items-summary.txt (brief list)
DocuSign room (orderform): https://app.docusign.com/rooms/ABC123-medallion-orderform

Appreciate the alignment — I will expect the redline by the 7th and will schedule a final review call if needed.

Best,
Chris Moore
Director, Security & Compliance (Medallion Health)

Chris / team — thanks again for the call and for moving on the notice window. Summarizing the agreed outcomes and next actions so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of outcomes: 
- Bounded inspection: agreed — limited to SOC2 assertion mapping, remote-first evidence delivery, and no production access. On-site inspections limited to two per 12 months unless mutually agreed.
- Pen test: 45 calendar days' notice required; testing limited to agreed non-production/staging environment; third-party tester acceptable to both parties.
- Evidence SLA: Redwood will acknowledge inbound requests within 2 business days and will use 10 business days as the target for standard artifact bundles; complex log/forensic requests will be tracked with an agreed delivery date.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Karthik Iyer: finalize tracked redline for the security exhibit and MSA by 2027-09-07 and upload to the DocuSign room.
- Laura Bennett: publish sample artifact bundle + runbook (template + expected response bands) by 2027-09-06 and share link in the folder.
- Grace O'Connor: create the DocuSign room and upload the current order form + action summary once Karthik confirms the redline (target 2027-09-08).
- Chris Moore / Medallion: review final redline and provide sign-off or narrow comments within 4 business days of redline upload.

Follow-up: we will hold a 20-minute final review call only if Medallion has open redline questions after Karthik circulates the draft.
